name: tinnitus-a-go-go-native
description: iOS shell for tinnitus-a-go-go: a Capacitor wrapper around the web app (jimbo-deploy templates/ios-shell).

scripts.build:sim: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build build
scripts.build:device: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath build -allowProvisioningUpdates build
